title: Computed marker: the marker key assembled at run time, so the probe answers correctly and the freeze is gone

violation.message: the marker key is assembled at run time instead of being a frozen literal, so the grep-level lint finds no definition site and nothing ties the value the probe answers to one source of truth

steps.step: The probe answers, and answers correctly: the assembled key resolves to the same marker, so this transcript is indistinguishable from a conforming one. Nothing at run time can see the violation, which is why the gate is a source scan.
